pre_condition: fqn is a fully-qualified function name string; callers_map maps FQN strings to iterables of caller FQN strings, where every caller FQN is a key in file_map; file_map maps FQN strings to absolute file paths that may or may not exist on disk; edge_aliases_map, if provided, maps callee FQN strings to dicts where each inner dict maps caller FQN strings to iterables of alias strings.
post_condition: Returns a list of (caller_fqn, caller_spec, callee_expectation) tuples, ordered by ascending caller_fqn string comparison. Each tuple corresponds to a caller of fqn whose file_map entry resolves to an existing file on disk. caller_spec is a dict containing the caller's own behavioral specification, or None when the caller has no such specification. callee_expectation is a formatted string containing the caller's expected signature, pre-condition, and post-condition for fqn, or None when the caller has no matching callee entry for fqn or any of its edge aliases. Callers with no existing file or no usable specification data are excluded. A tuple is present in the result only when at least one of caller_spec or callee_expectation is not None.
